description: Lists every page on vertodigital.com as a markdown index: one link and a one-line summary per page, grouped under section headings such as Services, Industries, Case studies, Content Hub and Agent API. Use it to discover what exists and to find slugs: each link has the form https://vertodigital.com/markdown/<slug>.md, and <slug> is the input vertodigital_get_page expects. Prefer vertodigital_search_case_studies to find a client result and vertodigital_get_value_proposition to match a buyer's challenge to a service. Fetched live from /llms.txt on every call (under 30 KB unfiltered). section narrows the output to the first heading containing it; a section that matches nothing returns the full index with section_found: false rather than an error.

section.description: Section heading to filter to, e.g. "Services", "Case studies", "Content Hub", "Industries". Case-insensitive substring match against the index's section headings. Omit to return the full index.

name: vertodigital_get_site_index

markdown.description: The document as markdown - identical to the text content block.

section.description: The section filter that was requested, or null for the full index

section_found.description: True when the requested section matched a heading; false when it did not and the full index was returned instead
